prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for VOICES, a warm cozy pixel-art top-down RPG educational game. Asset type: sixteen individual kitchen furnishings. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, equal square cells, 1024x1024 overall, REAL TRANSPARENT alpha background. Each object isolated, completely inside its cell, large empty gutters of at least 18 pixels on every side. View: consistent three-quarter top-down front view, same as RPG Maker interior props. Crisp hand-placed pixel clusters, warm dark brown 1-2 pixel outlines, restrained 4-tone shading, teal enamel, cream tile, honey wood, brushed muted silver. NOT photorealistic, no soft gradients or blur, no isometric diamond floor. No letters, labels, text, people, floor slabs, scenery or shadows extending to other cells. Row 1 left to right: (1) wooden food preparation island with a cutting board and a few vegetables, (2) teal stove and oven with a black pot and brass controls, (3) two-bowl stainless wash sink on cream cabinets, (4) tall wooden pantry glass cabinet filled with jars of beans, maize and flour. Row 2: (1) vintage teal refrigerator with brass handles, (2) wall-mounted wooden rack with copper and iron pots hanging underneath, (3) wooden baking table with a mixing bowl, flour sack and rolling pin, (4) small spice and herb trolley with colorful little jars. Row 3: (1) extractor hood with a short vertical duct, (2) dish drying rack with plates and glasses on a counter, (3) two compact covered compost and recycling bins together, (4) leafy culinary herbs in three ceramic planters. Row 4: (1) wooden double kitchen door with small glass panes, (2) tall cream-framed kitchen window showing a small blue sky patch and a sill plant, (3) red wall fire extinguisher in a simple bracket, (4) rolling serving cart with clean covered dishes. All sixteen assets must be individually readable, complete, with no overlaps between cells.

Row 4: (1) large leafy indoor tree in a terracotta pot, (2) low glass study display case with seeds, shells and simple pottery fragments, (3) warm brass hanging pendant lamp with a green shade and short cord, (4) low wooden reading shelf with stacked books and a rolled map.
